Substrate.label: Substrate code (every world)
Substrate.explain: Fixed code every world runs through: the Engine, compiler, run loop, service, records.

Family.label: Fixed people-world part
Family.explain: Fixed code every people world gets from compile_spec.py; the group-decision family is added when the description has a decision.

PerWorld.label: Written per world by an AI
PerWorld.explain: Not code: an AI writes it for each described world during the build.

Reference.label: Reference worlds code only
Reference.explain: Hand-written code for the reference worlds (Kitchen, Waltzman and others); no generated world uses it today.

Theory.label: In documents only
Theory.explain: Named in decisions or the roadmap, not on the live path.

nodes.label: World
nodes.explain: The one canonical world during a run: entities with typed components, a tick and a revision. Code: src/world_substrate/model.py:382.

nodes.label: Engine
nodes.explain: Applies each attempt atomically or refuses it with a recorded reason; runs due processes each tick. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:198.

nodes.label: Event
nodes.explain: The record of one attempt or process step: status, checks, changes, an id like r14-e00012. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:529.

nodes.label: Move (action)
nodes.explain: Something a person may try; its rule has checks and effects, compiled before use. Code: src/world_substrate/action_authoring.py:49.

nodes.label: Process
nodes.explain: A rule the world runs by itself each tick when its checks hold. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:829.

nodes.label: Compiler
nodes.explain: Turns proposed rules into installed rules and derives what each may read and write. Code: src/world_substrate/action_authoring.py:456.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.explain: What chooses a person's move: scripted or an AI model picks an offered move; a resident on the live path says an attempt in its own words. Installed mechanics, not its words, decide what happens. Code: src/world_substrate/policy.py:50.

nodes.label: Linguistic Core sense and roles
nodes.explain: The meaning and participant roles of a move kind, supplied by Linguistic Core; never its effects, quantities or timing. Code: src/world_substrate/semantic.py:15.

nodes.label: Frozen mechanic profile
nodes.explain: The validated, installed rules of a world, frozen under one id before any run; changing a rule means a new profile. Code: src/world_substrate/profile.py:266.

nodes.label: Declared write scope
nodes.explain: The fields a rule says it may change; the Engine refuses any change outside them. Read scopes are recorded, not enforced. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:88.

nodes.label: Causal trace
nodes.explain: The retained chain of events of a run, each naming the move or process, its checks and its changes; the evidence for any claim about a run. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:529.

nodes.label: World kind
nodes.explain: Two choices a build makes first: whether the description is about people (people path) or things (causal path), and whether the world is a task, ongoing or open. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:113.

nodes.label: World Builder and its bundle
nodes.explain: The public page and service where a person describes a world, approves its rules and watches it run; a build's output is an authoring bundle. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py.

nodes.label: Approval record
nodes.explain: A person's yes to the rules, stored with the rules' profile id and world fingerprint; every round names it. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:418.

nodes.label: World fingerprint
nodes.explain: A short hash of the bundle and rules that ties builds, rounds and shares to one world. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:381.

nodes.label: Information item
nodes.explain: A piece of information with a source and per-recipient deliveries; hidden until delivered. Code: src/world_substrate/information.py:57.

nodes.label: Run loop
nodes.explain: Each round: everyone decides, picks are submitted in a rotating order, then processes run. Code: scripts/run_authored_world.py:347.

nodes.label: Lost race
nodes.explain: When an earlier move this round changed the state, an open attempt is resubmitted as is at the new revision and only its rule's checks decide it; menu paths resubmit the move if still offered, else ask once more. The refused row names the failed checks, not the event that blocked it. Code: scripts/run_authored_world.py:563.

nodes.label: Resident
nodes.explain: One Concordia AI agent per person: sees its brief, memory and what it can see, and answers belief, attempt (in its own words), expected effect and work; the older menu reply picks an offered move. Code: scripts/concordia_residents.py:44.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.explain: A watched field value that takes several rounds, started by a person or the world, ended by a process: finished or failed part-way. Code: scripts/attempts.py:17.

nodes.label: Finished-task notice
nodes.explain: What the other people a finished task names are told, in the starter's own words about the work. Code: scripts/attempts.py:234.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.explain: Description to spec, actions, rules, assembly, scripted test run and score. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:1541.

nodes.label: Rules retry
nodes.explain: A second rules attempt after a rejection or weak score; skipped after 80 s. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:263.

nodes.label: Scripted test run
nodes.explain: The build's free run with simple moves that scores the rules and lists long tasks and whether each can fail part-way. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:1610.

nodes.label: Run log
nodes.explain: One line per request with its trace ids, cost and full artifacts; the source for shares and trace reads. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:524.

nodes.label: Readout
nodes.explain: One AI summary of a run whose every cited event id is checked against the run. Code: scripts/run_readout.py:125.

nodes.label: Scene replay
nodes.explain: The page's round-by-round picture of a run: who did what and said what, rebuilt from the run rows; it already quotes a retry's own words. Code: scripts/render_scene_replay.py:398.

nodes.label: Share link and replay
nodes.explain: A saved run rebuilt from the run log that a visitor replays with no AI calls. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:598.

nodes.label: Daily allowance
nodes.explain: Visitor $3/day, owner $5/day; spend fails closed. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:51.

nodes.label: People world
nodes.explain: A world built from a description about people: people, information, moments and the fixed people rules. Code: scripts/people_world.py:364.

nodes.label: Communicate rule
nodes.explain: The reviewed move that delivers an information item to its recipient. Spike code: it lives in spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/, which the live build loads through scripts/people_world.py:73. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:56.

nodes.label: Scheduled moment
nodes.explain: A countdown that happens every so many rounds (a weekly meeting, a deadline). Spike code: it lives in spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/, which the live build loads through scripts/people_world.py:73. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:48.

nodes.label: Work cycle
nodes.explain: Each action at most once per person per cycle of at least 3 rounds. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:517.

nodes.label: Group decision
nodes.explain: A decision with support, deadline, deployment and review; changed only by fixed rules. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:86.

nodes.label: Concern
nodes.explain: An objection a group holds on a delivered item: open, under remedy or resolved, with answered and remedy_by. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:70.

nodes.label: Support
nodes.explain: A member's stance on the decision: none, full or conditional on a concern. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:66.

nodes.label: Remedy
nodes.explain: A fix of a concern that takes 2 rounds; it can be stopped part-way by the concern's holder objecting. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:332.

nodes.label: Agenda count
nodes.explain: group_decision.agenda_items: a bare number of matters put before the decision; an item has no content. Declared in the group-decision component and changed by the compiled put-matter-on-agenda and settle-agenda-matter rules. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:101.

nodes.label: Rollout
nodes.explain: The deployment the world starts when the decision is authorized: 6 rounds, suspended if support falls. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:399.

nodes.label: Operating review
nodes.explain: Every 6 rounds after deployment; may reopen each resolved concern once. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:442.

nodes.label: Person and brief
nodes.explain: A person the spec names, with goals and beliefs, and the brief only their own resident reads. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/scenario_spec.py:41.

nodes.label: Generated actions and rules
nodes.explain: The moves and processes the fixed parts do not cover, written by the rules-writing AI and compiled. Code: scripts/people_world.py:251.

nodes.label: Waltzman reference components
nodes.explain: Trust, risk, readiness and commitment components and analyses of the hand-written Waltzman world. Code: reference_worlds/waltzman/components.py:11.

nodes.label: Build in an agent harness
nodes.explain: Decision 008: worlds built by an agent that drafts, checks and edits; scripts/world_harness.py exists but the live service does not call it. Code: scripts/world_harness.py.

nodes.label: Executable-law fingerprint
nodes.explain: Roadmap hardening item: fingerprint the exact executable law and compiler version. Code: none yet.

nodes.label: Affordance (offered move)
nodes.explain: A move the rules say a person can try now, with its open fields; the page a decider picks from or an attempt is read against. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:352.

nodes.label: Check
nodes.explain: One condition on a move or process (actual versus required); a move commits only when every check holds, else the event records which failed. Code: src/world_substrate/rules.py:48.

nodes.label: Attempt (in own words)
nodes.explain: What a resident says it physically tries, in its own words, with no outcome field: the world, not the speaker, decides what happens. Code: src/world_substrate/attempt.py:149.

nodes.label: Attempt reading
nodes.explain: The interpreter's typed reading of an attempt: one move kind, the entity for each role and the quoted words behind it; refused if it names unknown things or words not said. Code: src/world_substrate/attempt.py:81.

nodes.label: Unmatched attempt
nodes.explain: An attempt no move kind covers: it changes nothing, the person learns nothing came of it, and the run lists it for the rules writer. Code: src/world_substrate/attempt.py:25.

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.explain: What one actor sees this round: the fields its senses and position allow, never the whole world. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:235.

nodes.label: Place and way
nodes.explain: Where things are, and what lies between two places (a door, a brick wall) with whether it is passable; written per world as entities from the bundle contract, and the move rule checks the way. Code: scripts/generate_world_bundle.py:96.

nodes.label: Knock-on that runs now
nodes.explain: Plan S2: a process marked 'immediately' runs again and again inside one moment until nothing more changes (a glass falls, breaks, someone hears it). Code: none yet.

nodes.label: Skill roll
nodes.explain: Plan S3: a move's outcome depends on a seeded, recorded roll against the person's skill, so someone untrained who flies a helicopter can crash it. Code: none yet.

nodes.label: Living projection
nodes.explain: The read-only living client, JSON and server-sent events rebuilt from canonical snapshots and events; it never changes the world. Code: src/world_substrate/projection.py:44.

nodes.label: Hard causal parent
nodes.explain: An earlier event a rule declares as mechanically supporting this one; kept apart from the information a person merely had in mind. Code: src/world_substrate/rules.py:383.

nodes.label: Derived exchange
nodes.explain: A composite reading (two give events make one exchange) derived from committed events, never a second effect. Code: src/world_substrate/exchange.py:20.

nodes.label: Mechanisms library
nodes.explain: Reusable hand-written rule families (liquid, ownership, thermal, damage, time) that reference worlds such as Castaway register (reference_worlds/castaway/overheat.py:14); generated worlds start with an empty registry (Q28). Code: src/world_substrate/mechanisms/__init__.py:3.

nodes.label: Kitchen flagship
nodes.explain: The replicated scarce-knife watched world: hand-written rules of its own on the ordinary Engine. Code: reference_worlds/kitchen/mechanics.py.
